description: Search beyond the meetings: one made-up person's notes (a boiler service, car insurance, gifts, a trip, a vet, a kitchen, an allotment…), two work meetings, their past chats with Yap and what Yap remembers about them (fictional people, firms and details throughout), with questions of five kinds, each with the items that answer it. `box`: words typed in the Notes view's search (the gold notes; `meaning` tags those whose words aren't in them). `tool`: what Chat's search_notes is called with, as a model writes it. `chats`: a question about an earlier chat (search_chats). `memory`: a Chat question and the people, projects and topics it's about (none: nothing in memory is). `chat`: a question asked in Chat (not across meetings), with words its answer must hold (`expect`, any one). Used by `yap.exe eval --search` (src-tauri/src/ai/eval/library.rs): recall@k before (Yap's keyword searches until 25 Oct 2026) and after (src-tauri/src/search/library.rs), and with --model each `chat` question answered (with --search-keyword, as before).

chats.title: Lisbon food
messages: user
Where should we eat in Lisbon on the first night?
assistant
Try a small tasca in Alfama for grilled sardines, or the market hall at Cais do Sodré if everyone wants something different.

chats.title: Sourdough help
messages: user
My sourdough comes out too dense, what am I doing wrong?
assistant
It's probably under-proved: give the bulk ferment longer, until the dough has grown by about half, and keep it somewhere warmer.

chats.title: Interview prep
messages: user
I have an interview for a product manager role on Friday. What should I prepare?
assistant
Prepare two stories about shipping something, one about a disagreement you resolved, and questions about how they set priorities.

chats.title: Bike repair
messages: user
My bike chain keeps slipping when I pedal hard.
assistant
The chain or the cassette is probably worn. Measure the chain's stretch, and check the derailleur hanger isn't bent.

chats.title: Party ideas
messages: user
Ideas for a seventh birthday party at home?
assistant
A treasure hunt round the garden, a decorate-your-own cupcake table, and a short film to finish.

chats.title: Tax return
messages: user
When is the deadline for my self assessment?
assistant
The online deadline is 31 January; a paper return is due by 31 October.
